sourceDate.text: 孝文即位，將軍陳武等議曰

translationRepairs: Dalu is the pitch-pipe in which yin qi is gathered and stored.

s0075 is only the incomplete lemma 「大呂者。」; neighboring s0073 shows a full 者…也 gloss pattern, but this unit has no yin-qi wording, so the before idiomatic invents content and the proposed 'Dalu.' matches the Chinese.
Dalu ones, yin qi gathered stored.
The Chinese of s0075 is only 「大呂者。」; the before literal's 'yin qi gathered stored' is not present in the unit, and 'Dalu ones.' is the accurate parallel to the chapter's 者 literal style.
